name: banking77_v3
instructions: What is the customer asking about or reporting in this message to a digital bank's support chat? Choose the single most specific intent.

criteria.activate_my_card: wants to activate / start using a new card they received; card activation
criteria.age_limit: asks about minimum age or age requirements to open/use an account (e.g. can my child have one)
criteria.apple_pay_or_google_pay: using Apple Pay or Google Pay: adding the card to it, paying with it, topping up with it
criteria.atm_support: which ATMs can be used, where to find an ATM, whether an ATM/machine is compatible or supported
criteria.automatic_top_up: setting up, enabling, disabling or fixing automatic top-up (auto top up)
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: a bank transfer was made and the balance has not changed or the money is not showing in the account
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: deposited a cheque or cash and the balance has not updated / funds not showing
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: cannot add or send money to a beneficiary/recipient; beneficiary not permitted or rejected
criteria.cancel_transfer: wants to cancel or reverse a transfer they just made
criteria.card_about_to_expire: card is expiring soon; how to renew or get a replacement for an expiring card
criteria.card_acceptance: where the card is accepted, which merchants/shops/places take it
criteria.card_arrival: ordered card has not arrived yet; where is my card; tracking the card delivery
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: how long card delivery will take; delivery time estimates, express delivery, delivery cost
criteria.card_linking: linking/connecting an existing card to the app or account (adding an external card)
criteria.card_not_working: the card does not work, general complaint that the card is not working (no specific type such as contactless or virtual)
criteria.card_payment_fee_charged: a fee was charged on a card payment; vague hidden or too many fees tied to the card
criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: a card payment, purchase or transaction explicitly described as a payment/purchase the customer did not make or does not recognise
criteria.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: wrong or unfair exchange rate was applied to a card payment made abroad / in foreign currency
criteria.card_swallowed: an ATM/machine kept or swallowed the card
criteria.cash_withdrawal_charge: charged a fee or extra charge for withdrawing cash
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: a cash withdrawal on the account that the customer did not make or does not recognise; cash shown on the balance they did not receive
criteria.change_pin: change or update an existing PIN (how, where, at an ATM, online, at a bank)
criteria.compromised_card: card or card details were compromised: someone used the card, fraud, card details leaked or hacked
criteria.country_support: which countries the service/card is available or supported in
criteria.declined_card_payment: a card payment was declined or rejected
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: a cash withdrawal at an ATM was declined or rejected
criteria.declined_transfer: a bank transfer was declined or rejected
criteria.direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: a vague unknown, unauthorised or disputed charge with no payment type given; a direct debit the customer does not recognise
criteria.disposable_card_limits: limits or restrictions on disposable (single-use) cards
criteria.edit_personal_details: change or update personal details: name, address, phone number, email, date of birth
criteria.exchange_charge: fees or charges for exchanging currencies, FX fee, discounted rates for frequent exchange
criteria.exchange_rate: asks what the exchange rate is or how it is determined (general question, not a complaint about a specific payment)
criteria.exchange_via_app: exchanging or converting currency inside the app; supported currencies for exchange in the app
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: only a small extra amount (about 1 pound/dollar/euro) added on a statement
criteria.failed_transfer: a transfer failed or did not go through (not simply declined)
criteria.fiat_currency_support: which fiat currencies can be held, exchanged or used; whether a particular currency is supported
criteria.get_disposable_virtual_card: how to get/create a disposable (single-use) virtual card
criteria.get_physical_card: questions about the card's PIN when it is not a change: do I have a PIN, haven't received my PIN, can't find or see the PIN, how to get or first set the PIN. NOT about ordering a card
criteria.getting_virtual_card: how to get or create a virtual card (non-disposable)
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: card is lost or stolen / missing
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: phone is lost or stolen and worried about account/app access
criteria.order_physical_card: how to get, order or obtain a physical/plastic card, where to order, whether a new card is free or has charges
criteria.passcode_forgotten: forgot the passcode / password to the app or account
criteria.pending_card_payment: a card payment is pending / still processing
criteria.pending_top_up: a top-up is pending / not yet completed
criteria.pending_transfer: a transfer is pending, has not gone through yet, or an outgoing transfer is taking long
criteria.pin_blocked: PIN is blocked or locked, too many wrong PIN attempts
criteria.receiving_money: how to receive money into the account; how someone can send money to them
criteria.Refund_not_showing_up: an expected refund has not appeared in the account yet
criteria.request_refund: wants to request a refund or get money back for a purchase
criteria.reverted_card_payment?: a card payment was reverted, returned, cancelled or reversed (payment didn't go through and money came back)
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: which cards (e.g. American Express, Visa, Mastercard) and currencies are supported for top-up or use
criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: fee or charge for topping up by bank transfer
criteria.top_up_by_card_charge: fee or charge for topping up by card
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: topping up the account by cash or cheque; how to
criteria.top_up_failed: a top-up failed or did not work
criteria.top_up_limits: limits on the amount that can be topped up
criteria.top_up_reverted: a top-up was reverted / reversed / money returned
criteria.topping_up_by_card: how to top up the account using a card
criteria.transaction_charged_twice: charged twice / duplicate charge for the same transaction
criteria.transfer_fee_charged: a fee was charged for a transfer; also vague complaints about fees or higher fees after using the account abroad
criteria.transfer_into_account: how to transfer money into the account from another bank/account
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: a transfer was sent but a named recipient/friend has not received it; transfer taking too long to arrive
criteria.transfer_timing: general question about how long transfers take; transfer times
criteria.unable_to_verify_identity: identity verification failing, cannot complete or pass identity verification
criteria.verify_my_identity: how to verify identity; what is needed for identity verification
criteria.verify_source_of_funds: verifying the source of funds / proof of where money comes from
criteria.verify_top_up: verifying a top-up (verification code, top-up verification step)
criteria.virtual_card_not_working: the virtual card does not work or cannot be used for payments (online, subscriptions, memberships)
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: any message that names Visa or Mastercard as the card network: whether the card is Visa or Mastercard, can they choose, or wanting to get a Visa/Mastercard card
criteria.why_verify_identity: why identity verification is required; do I have to verify; can I use the account without verifying
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: received the wrong amount of cash from an ATM (less or more than requested)
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: wrong exchange rate applied to a cash withdrawal abroad
